archive_contents: Original verifier reward.json files for scored attempts and one submitted model.patch per attempt where available. An empty patch is an original zero-byte artifact. Paths are relative to the ZIP root. SHA-256 values are computed from the original file bytes.

entries.note: The verifier stalled on the original run and on re-verification of the frozen patch. The published 88/113 includes this as a non-pass.

scope: The public ten-harness comparison and the two senior-dev follow-up campaigns in PR #2866.

grading.graded_patch_verification: All 1,350 scored attempts have a submitted patch byte-identical to the copy saved by their verifier.
grading.ungraded_patch_verification: An available submitted patch for an ungraded attempt has no matching scored verifier result.
